attributes.title: PAs By The Bay: Monterey 2027
attributes.summary:
CAPA's Northern California meeting returns to Monterey on February 19 and 20, 2027, at the Monterey Beach Hotel. Friday is a pre-conference of industry-supported, hands-on workshops; Saturday is a full day of accredited clinical lectures with a primary care focus. CAPA lists up to 7.0 Category 1 CME units.

Registration costs $200 for CAPA members, $600 for nonmembers and $65 for CAPA student members, with separate contact-only rates for nonmember students and retired members. The group hotel rate is $239 per night, with the destination fee waived, until January 19, 2027.

The program and speakers are not published yet.
